title: Love's Long Shadow
overview: They say love is blind, but Frank Barnett is about to get a clear look at the past. Set against the contrasting backdrops of a rainy Golden Gate tragedy and the unforgiving Texas sun, this neo-noir thriller tests the bonds of engagement. Frank fights to save his relationship from a lethal obsession, forcing him to confront the question: Can you ever truly know the person you’re about to marry, or are we all just shadows of our history?
